text:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: elevated error rate from prefix cache mismatch detected for tenant 'edge-payments' — 5xx increase + KV read bypasses. Auto-page to oncall.
oncall-chris: I'm on it. what's the current impact? numbers?
ops-bot: 5xx rate is 12% over baseline in the last 3m. Cache hit ratio dropped 35% for prefix /edge-payments/*; read-throughs increased ~4x. Latency p95 up from 110ms -> 420ms. Rolling 5m tail: increased downstream DB ops.
pranav: tagging runtime. can we confirm if this is correctness bypass (forced bypass) vs eviction storm?
sara: checking logs — looks like a recent rollout to prefix-coherency-change flag at 2117999000 triggered a fallback to bypass on miss for certain keys. partial deploy rolled for canary -> looks like 60% of nodes picked new behavior.
alex: if it's correctness bypass, we should prefer correctness but need to throttle traffic to avoid DB overload. propose: 1) temporary per-tenant soft quota cut 30% 2) enable prefix-level circuit-breaker to reject new cold prefixes 3) route reads through degraded but cached variant.
jamie: agree. Also we can flip the flag back on older runtime at cluster level to restore previous behavior while we investigate.
oncall-chris: immediate steps? I can issue soft quota cut and a temporary traffic-shaper at the edge. who's running the quota command?
support-lucy: I'll draft customer comms once we have impact window. which tenants affected? just edge-payments? ops-bot shows a small tail for edge-analytics too.
pranav: actions: prio-1: soft quota for edge-payments - reduce token quota by 30%; prio-2: prefix-circuit-breaker on unknown prefixes; prio-3: rollback canary to previous flag.
alex: commands ready:

```
# reduce quota for tenant
rictl tenant update-quotas --tenant edge-payments --requests-per-minute 7000 # was 10000

# enable prefix circuit breaker
rictl routing set-prefilter --prefix "/edge-payments/" --mode circuit-break --error-threshold 5 --window 60s

# rollback runtime flag
rictl rollout revert-config --config prefix-coherency-change --target canary
```

sara: I'm watching the logs while you run these. recommend also pausing prefetch for this tenant to avoid extra read amplification.
jamie: +1 on pausing prefetch. command below:

```
rictl model set-feature-flags --tenant edge-payments --prefetch-enabled false
```

oncall-chris: executing soft quota cut now.

oncall-chris: /bin/exec: ran `rictl tenant update-quotas --tenant edge-payments --requests-per-minute 7000` -> response: OK (delta applied).
pranav: enabling prefix circuit breaker in 3,2,1...

eng-runtime-bot: deployment job started: set-prefilter /edge-payments/ -> job id j-1942
eng-runtime-bot: job j-1942: applied to 12/12 nodes

sara: prefetch pause applied.

ops-bot: telemetry note: after quota cut and circuit-breaker, 5xx rate dropped to 4.2% in 90s; DB op rate back down ~45% of peak. latency p95 down to 190ms.

support-lucy: drafting customer note: "We detected a cache fallback behavior that increased backend reads for your tenant leading to intermittent 5xx. We've applied temporary quotas and traffic shaping to protect overall stability. We're rolling back the recent canary and will follow up with a root cause and timeline."

jamie: initiating rollback of the prefix-coherency-change canary.
eng-runtime-bot: rollout revert-config j-2001 -> 60% -> done across canary set.

pranav: monitoring: after rollback, cache hit ratio gradually recovering. ops-bot shows KV read-through reduction to baseline in ~6m.

oncall-chris: handoff note: I'm paged but leaving for 30m. passing on to pr anav for monitoring. pr anav, take over the thread.

pranav: taking over. next steps: 1) run a quicker canary with more conservative fallback behavior 2) add a safeguard so bypass doesn't trigger for prefixes with high cardinality 3) create an eval to detect this pattern in future.

alex: I'll open a post-incident task: "prefix bypass safety - add cardinality threshold + prefetch backoff" and include configuration patches + tests. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml for follow-up.

support-lucy: customers notified. Will monitor for follow-ups.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations reduced error rate to near-baseline; no broad customer escalations recorded. keep thread open for RCA and remediation tasks.

pranav: logging RCA notes here: cause = canary change to prefix coherency logic changed fallback semantics (aggressive bypass for certain key patterns). contributing factor = lack of cardinality guard + prefetch enabled. mitigation = rollback canary + soft quotas + circuit-breaker + prefetch pause. remediation = throttle on bypass path + cardinality threshold + post-deploy evals.

jamie: I'll pick up the remediation PR.

oncall-chris: thanks team. leaving the channel. :thumbsup:

pranav: last check 2118002799: metrics stable. closing active mitigation. opening incident ticket with timeline and owners.

ops-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: mitigations successful; follow-up tasks assigned.
